title.narrative: Share of cold storage units that have adopted energy efficiency measures

title.narrative: Share of trained women employed in technical and managerial roles in logistics services

comment.narrative: The indicator will track the share of women trained in logistics sector skill-development programs under the operation who are employed in technical roles. GoWB is identifying the kind of technical training required. They are talking to stakeholders including service providers and institutes who can impart this training. The PforR team has consulted relevant trade, agriculture, Social, gender experts to prepare for the TA if needed

title.narrative: Investment plans in the West Bengal Industrial and Economic Corridor

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the development of various investment plans needed to develop the industrial corridor. The IVA will report on the fact that the Detailed Project Reports of Industrial corridor investment plans are aligned with i) State government Environment and Social safeguards, (ii) align with the quality and content of the State Masterplan, West Bengal Logistics Policy and Gati Shakti. The DPRs are currently being reviewed by the IVA.
